'''Tili Tili''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] who lived on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Sometime after [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> Tili Tili teamed up with a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Band/Legends|band]] and helped a [[Unidentified young new recruit|young Jedi recruit]] create a songbook for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He provided the recruit with a certificate for successfully transcribing dozens of songs.<ref name="YCAC" />
